content: JWT refresh rotation with reuse detection: issue refresh token bound to a familyId (uuid, stable across a login's lineage) and a per-token id (jti); store a DB row per issued refresh token with a hash of the token (never raw), revokedAt, expiresAt; on refresh, hash the presented token and look up by id - if the row is missing/already revoked, reuse is detected -> revoke entire family (all rows sharing familyId); logout revokes the presented token's row (or whole family). A short grace window can absorb legitimate concurrent-retry races.
